method: TypeScript AST traversal of every .ts/.js source under every servers/*/src directory; exact upgradeText call expressions, including multiline code. Each occurrence and helper alias was manually reviewed and refusal-string helpers traced to their callers. This is source evidence, not complete runtime certification.
limits: No complete functional certification of all estate tools is implied by a source scan. Seventeen affected server stdio regressions are recorded separately.
Historical unread reports and ambiguous project-resolution questions can still return ordinary non-error answers; this work does not redefine those policies.

Successful partial evidence and metadata help intentionally retain upgrade text. Examples: image dominant colors, currency/clamped history, invoice business/PDF, service-agreement clause-library titles, checklist/purchase-requisition/packing-slip inline reports and new-matcher unsaved diagnostics.
remote/src/vendor is generated separately by the coordinator and must be regenerated, compiled and exercised before deployment. This inventory hashes primary server source only.
